tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Check how many fax credits remain on your account. Requires your credits API key (sfx_...).

tools.name: get_fax_price
tools.description: Check if a fax destination is supported and how many credits it costs (a flat 1 credit per fax, up to 100 pages). No API key required. Supported: USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and 39 more countries (same list as sendfaxfast.com); premium-rate numbers are not supported.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Send a fax using 1 prepaid credit. Requires your credits API key (sfx_...) and a direct, publicly accessible HTTPS link to a PDF (max. 10 MB, 100 pages). tools.name: get_fax_status
tools.description: Check the delivery status of one of your faxes. Use the fax_id returned by send_fax. Requires your credits API key; only your own faxes are visible.

tools.name: create_upload_link
